summary: Princeton Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K solely to announce a quarterly cash dividend of $0.35 per share declared by its Board of Directors, payable May 28, 2026 to shareholders of record as of May 5, 2026. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation content; it is a routine capital-return announcement common for a bank holding company. The press release reiterates that future dividends are discretionary and subject to financial condition and regulatory restrictions. No special situation is triggered—the dividend is ordinary-course, pre-scheduled, and does not indicate an activist campaign or capital-return event. There are no deal terms to capture.
